title: Enchanted Items
description: Adds a few powerful items to your game.
body:
There are 7 items that can be crafted in this small Datapack. They each have individual abilities:
-Energy Blaster (Shoots laser projectiles)
-Energy Ring (Release an amethyst ring, following enemies)
-Energy Orb (An orb that deals damage to nearby enemies)
-Whirlwind (Summon a powerful tornado)
-B-Omb (Instant kill everything in front of you)
-Enchanted Diamond Sword (Ranged slash attack)
-Cursed Eye (Summon cursed eye monster...)
